raw_response:
I grow sorghum on this 1.13 hectare plot in Mtwara, and I did not go to school, so I do not use chemical fertilizers or bought seeds because they are too expensive and I do not know how to use them well. My family will do most of the work with hand hoes, and I will hire maybe twenty days of labor when the weeding is heavy, but we rely on the rains and our own strength to bring in the crop.
